page.overview:
Who is Giant?

Two appear in the in the , guarding the . They are awakened by howling "", and ask that he solve their puzzle in order to enter the true . Once has completed the puzzle, the will yield passage to the location of the .

A third stands in front of the ; when returns to the during his search for the , he thrusts the into the , causing the to disappear and granting him access to the .
